binary: rustc
commit-hash: 59807616e1fa2540724bfbac14d7976d7e4a3860
commit-date: 2026-04-14
host: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
release: 1.95.0
LLVM version: 22.1.2
build_command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO=false cargo build --release --manifest-path tools/perf-baseline/Cargo.toml --bin litchi-perf-baseline
lock_policy: External copy of tools/perf-baseline/Cargo.lock passed through -Z lockfile-path and resolver.lockfile-path; repository lockfiles unchanged. Facade validation used a separate external root lock with cc 1.7.0 downgraded to cached 1.6.0.
method: Fourteen separate pair invocations in count order (1,10,100,256,1000,4096,10000), eager then positional. Native leg then unified leg; one warmup and five samples each. No concurrent builds or tests. Runtime sources committed; documentation uncommitted. Blocked leg order, not alternating AB/BA.
timing_scope: Opening, fixture and command-vector preparation, serialization and byte/source checks excluded. String path parsing, native/unified publication and patch destruction included. 1k uses default snapshot limit; 10k explicitly uses 1 GiB. Native 256-item chunks with 4096-operation rollover; unified uses one atomic facade edit.
limitations: Synthetic same-slide text closure edits only, local warm prepared owners. No command-batch JSON conversion, geometry, cold opens, broad corpus or allocation qualification. Blocked leg order can retain drift. Per-chunk append-only publication remains; relative speedup does not establish linear scaling.
